question: In FastDyn/QEMU simulation of TROPIC RT1064 firmware against one shared plant, which stack follows the shorter reference lap within the tracking gates?
definition_of_faster: The shortest reference lap duration, on the tested 1 s grid, at which a stack passes the tracking rule on all 15 confirmation runs. This is a commanded schedule on one 47.147 m figure-eight, not a race-gate lap time, a hardware speed or a physical maximum.

fixed_conditions.course: 10 x 10 m figure-eight at 2 m, one lap, minimum_jerk_each_lap, unchanged geometry
fixed_conditions.betaflight_motor_protocol_note: Matches the existing lead-on campaign. A single matched pair (35 s, harsh, seed 2) landed under ONESHOT125 and not under PWM with near-identical tracking. ONESHOT125 runs are a labelled diagnostic and never replace PWM cells under this rule.
fixed_conditions.only_difference_between_cells: stack firmware and controller.feedforward (omega or off)

cells.status_at_drafting: complete on runner 7c9ade, already observed; 33 s passes tracking 15/15; parity check required
not searched; five realistic-noise comparator runs at 33 s already observed

search.stop_coarse: first flight that fails the tracking rule (realistic noise, seed 1)
search.refinement: descend in 1 s steps from the last passing coarse value; stop at the first tracking failure
search.fallback: if any confirmation fails the tracking rule, confirm the next slower tested candidate with all 15 runs
search.landing_only_failure_during_search: counts as a tracking pass. The existing runner stops on report.passed, which includes landing; the operator then starts the next shorter candidate with the same command and records that this happened.
search.order: one QEMU flight at a time; Betaflight lead-off first, then CogniPilot lead-off

tracking_rule.geometry: four ordered quadrants, +/-4.25 m extents, center return within 0.75 m, no second lap
tracking_rule.complete_run: process completed and simulated_seconds equals the configured mission length
tracking_rule.landing: excluded from this rule; see landing_score
tracking_rule.gates_are_fixed: No gate changes, tie-breakers or finer grids after any cell is observed.

incomplete_runs: A stalled, timed-out or truncated flight is neither a pass nor a fail. Rerun the same cell up to 2 times. Retain and publish every incomplete attempt and the count. A candidate with a cell still incomplete after 2 reruns cannot be selected.

runner_parity.check: Rerun Betaflight lead-on at 33 s and 32 s, realistic noise, seed 1, on runner f2ef29.
runner_parity.pass: tracking_rms_m and tracking_max_m equal to the 7c9ade results within 1e-6 m, and the same tracking verdict
runner_parity.if_fail: Repeat the Betaflight lead-on search and confirmation on f2ef29 before scoring that cell.

landing_score.report: For each selected candidate: runs with verified ground contact, firmware disarm and four stopped motors, out of 15.
landing_score.full_mission_result: The shortest candidate passing both the tracking rule and landing on 15/15, reported alongside the tracking result. 'None' is a valid entry.
landing_score.disclosure: Betaflight landing failures under PWM may come from the 500 Hz loop imposed by the PWM setting; do not present a landing difference as a stack property.

scoring.stack_score: the shorter selected lap of the stack's two cells; record which feedforward mode produced it
scoring.verdict: Compare stack scores. Shorter is faster under this rule. Equal scores are a tie.
scoring.tie_wording: indistinguishable at 1 s resolution under this rule
also_report: all four cells, including failures and incomplete runs
margin to 0.75 m at every selected lap
matched-seed maximum-error differences at the deciding lap
tracking result and full-mission result as two named results

already_observed: cognipilot off at 33 s realistic seeds 1-5
attitude-lag analysis of all 33 s flights
evidence_status_at_commit.statement: The rule was written after the lead-on results were known. Only the lead-off searches are scored blind.

data_freeze: 2026-11-14T12:00:00-05:00. After this, only reruns of incomplete cells.

required_wording.headline_prefix: Under the committed speed-ranking rule, in FastDyn/QEMU simulation of TROPIC firmware against one shared plant:
required_wording.scope: Exploratory result, not a qualified ranking. ARM gain requalification, onboard rate-command checks and the non-inferiority margin remain open (docs/simulation-qualification.md). Noise levels are assumed. No hardware timing, latency or physical speed claim.
required_wording.relation_to_qualification_doc: docs/simulation-qualification.md counts landing as a gate. This rule reports that landing-inclusive result as the full-mission result and the landing-free result as the tracking result; neither replaces the other.
